content: When J1939Nm_TxConfirmation is called with result E_OK for the initial AddressClaimed PG of a NodeChannel ( transmitted during the transition to the ‘Claiming’ sub state ) , the J1939 Network Management module shall start the delay timer for this NodeChannel .
